prompts.headline: Jedna veta, ktorá predá
prompts.prompt: Reproduce the product exactly from the reference image: <popis produktu — tvar, farba, etiketa>. Place it slightly right of centre on a clean surface with a soft contact shadow. Headline at the top, large and bold: 'Jedna veta, ktorá predá'. Small supporting line below it: 'Krátky benefit produktu'. Rounded CTA button at the bottom: 'Kúpiť teraz'. Render EXACTLY these texts, nothing else — never render font names, sizes or colour codes as text.

prompts.headline: Bežné produkty vs. my
prompts.prompt: Reproduce the product exactly from the reference image. Vertical split comparison: left muted grey column labelled 'Bežné produkty' with a generic unbranded competitor and three weaknesses marked with a red X; right column in the brand colour labelled with our product and three strengths with green checkmarks; small 'VS' badge at the top centre. Texts: left 'Rýchlo vyprchá', 'Drahé', 'Chémia'; right 'Vydrží týždne', 'Výhodné', 'Prírodné'. Render EXACTLY these texts, nothing else.
